newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield to buy 43 pct of Gentra.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield to buy 43 pct of Gentra.

text.p: Brookfield Properties Corp, a unit of Edperbrascan Corp, said on Tuesday that it agreed to acquire a 43 percent stake in real estate firm Gentra Inc from Trilon Financial Corp.
Brookfield said it would pay C$262.4 million to acquire 72.9 million common shares at a price of C$3.60 each.
The deal is expected to close by September 30.

The Edperbrascan unit said it agreed to pay for the acquisition with C$175 million in cash and by issuing 4.6 million Brookfield common shares. The shares, now halted on the Toronto Stock Exchange, closed at 19 on Monday.

"Brookfield supports Gentra's current business plan which focuses on acquiring real estate properties in Canada and enhancing their value by repositioning them in the marketplace prior to sale," Brookfield President Bruce Flatt said in a statement.
Trilon said it wished to divest part of the real estate firm since it was no longer a strategic investment. Trilon will record a C$200 million gain from the sale.

Trilon added it planned to use the funds to expand its investment banking, brokerage, commercial financing and merchant banking operations. The company will also keep its C$237 million stake in Gentra preferred shares for investment purposes.

Trilon is another Edperbrascan unit and the deal simplifies the parent company's corporate structure since all North American real estate activities would be channeled through Brookfield and affiliates, they said.
The acquisition increases Brookfield's proportionally consolidated book capital base to about C$2.5 billion.
